notes: Keral Keep Disciples, printed: 'Whenever you activate a loyalty ability of a Chandra planeswalker, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.' Your Chandra, Flame's Catalyst +1 (3 damage to each opponent) triggers it once: P1 20-3-1 = 16, P0 untouched. Your Basri Ket +1 (not a Chandra) must not trigger it: P1 stays 16 and the Disciples get Basri's counter.
